cases.title: Request: the top-level system string becomes the first system message; max_tokens becomes max_completion_tokens, stop_sequences becomes stop; temperature, top_p and top_k pass; model passes unchanged (the caller rewrites it); metadata is dropped
Request: system blocks join their text with a blank line into one system message; user text blocks become text parts; cache_control is dropped; empty stop_sequences are left out

Request: Claude Code puts role "system" entries into messages; they go on as user text inside <system-reminder>, as in systemMessagesAsReminders, because the chat templates behind a provider refuse a second system message; an empty top-level system is left out
Request: a base64 image becomes an image_url part with a data URL, a URL image keeps its URL; the order of parts stays
Request: client tools become functions with input_schema as parameters (no description stays without one); server tools without input_schema (web_search) are dropped; tool_choice auto stays auto
Request: tool_choice any means a tool must be called (required); disable_parallel_tool_use sets parallel_tool_calls false
Request: tool_choice for one named tool becomes a function choice of that name
Request: tool_choice none stays none
Request: when no client tool is left, tools and tool_choice are left out; an empty provider tool list is an error at several providers

Request: assistant tool_use blocks become tool_calls with the input as JSON text (keys sorted, no spaces); thinking blocks are dropped; user tool_result blocks become role "tool" messages in block order, text blocks after them a user message; is_error is dropped (Claude Code already writes the error into the content)

Request: an assistant turn of only tool_use has content null; a tool_result without content is an empty tool message; images inside tool results cannot go into a tool message and follow the run of tool messages as one user message
Request: thinking enabled maps its budget to reasoning_effort (below 4096 low, below 16384 medium, else high); stream true adds stream_options.include_usage so the last chunk carries the usage
Request: a thinking budget of 1024 is low effort; stream false is left out
Request: a thinking budget of 31999 (ultrathink) is high effort
Request: thinking disabled sets no reasoning_effort
Request: adaptive thinking takes output_config.effort (max and xhigh are high); without an effort it is medium
Request: adaptive thinking without output_config.effort is medium
Request: a body without a messages list is refused (the gateway answers 400 invalid_request_error)

Response: message text becomes one text block; stop is end_turn; prompt_tokens includes the cached tokens, Anthropic counts them apart, so input_tokens = prompt_tokens - cached_tokens; the model is the one the client asked for

Response: reasoning_content becomes a thinking block first; tool_calls become tool_use blocks with the arguments parsed; arguments that are not a JSON object give input {} and keep the text in raw_arguments; empty arguments are {}; tool_calls is tool_use; no id gives msg_modlight
Response: finish_reason length is max_tokens; a missing usage counts zero
Response: content_filter is end_turn; empty text gives no text block; the reasoning field (vLLM's name) is read like reasoning_content
Response: some providers say stop although the message calls tools; tool calls always mean tool_use, else Claude Code would not run them; a call without id gets call_<position>
Response: a body without choices is an empty end_turn message

Stream: message_start on the first chunk, a text block opened by the first non-empty text, closed at the end; message_delta takes the stop reason and the usage of the final usage chunk (choices empty)
Stream: reasoning_content opens a thinking block, the first text closes it and opens a text block; usage in the finish chunk itself is used too
Stream: the first tool call streams live as a tool_use block with input_json_delta; empty argument pieces send nothing; tool calls stop with tool_use

Stream: Anthropic blocks cannot interleave, OpenAI tool-call deltas can; the first tool call streams live, every later one is collected and sent whole (start, one input_json_delta, stop) after it at the end, in order of first appearance
Stream: finish_reason length is max_tokens; without a usage chunk the usage is zero
Stream: an upstream that closes without a chunk still gives a complete Anthropic stream
Stream: an error object inside the stream becomes an Anthropic error event and ends the translation; later chunks and finish send nothing
Error: OpenAI's {error: {message}} keeps its message; the status picks the Anthropic type (429 rate_limit_error)
Error: {error: "text"} (Venice) keeps the text; 402 is billing_error
Error: a top-level message field is read too; 422 (validation) is invalid_request_error like every 4xx without its own type
Error: FastAPI-style {detail: "text"} is read; 401 is authentication_error
Error: a body that is not JSON is the message itself; 503 is overloaded_error
Error: without a readable message the status is named; 413 is request_too_large
Error: 529 is overloaded_error, other 5xx api_error
Error: 500 is api_error; whitespace-only messages count as none

count_tokens estimate (the provider has none): Unicode scalars of every text that reaches the model, i.e. system text, message text, thinking, tool_use name + input as JSON (sorted keys, no spaces), tool_result text, tool name + description + input_schema as JSON, divided by 4 and rounded up; plus 1600 per image. Here 4+12+3+2+4+13+9 = 47 scalars -> 12
count_tokens estimate: tools count with name, description and schema (4+5+17), "Wäs?" is 4 scalars, so 30 scalars -> 8, plus 1600 for the image and 1600 for the image inside the tool result: 3208
